steps.name: prepare-dev-tools-and-implement
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; echo 'English-only execution evidence.'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f2530e11b3be8a3f9c50a221592d3ad5fc8479f4; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/pre-commit ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; fi; git fetch origin agent-control; mkdir -p tools/schema; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage2/generate_climate_contract.py > tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage2/install_climate_core.py > /tmp/install-climate-core.py; .venv/bin/python -m py_compile tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py /tmp/install-climate-core.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/install-climate-core.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff-format --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff --all-files; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff-format --all-files; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --all-files; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-climate-v6-tests
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mvp_contract_v6.py tests/test_climate_contract_codegen.py -q; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R climate_v6_tests --output-on-failure; git diff --check; git diff --stat

verify_steps.name: full-local-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py lib/environment_control/src/climate test/test_climate_v6 tests/test_climate_contract_codegen.py test/host/CMakeLists.txt scripts/check_schema.sh scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh docs/MVP_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLLER.md; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate v6 state encoder and trends'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
